description: This Java source file defines the RssReaderActivity class for an Android application. Its purpose is to create a simple RSS feed reader that uses XML adapters to parse and display feed elements, and includes an item click listener to open news articles in a browser.

classes.name: RssReaderActivity
classes.description: An Android ListActivity that loads and displays an RSS feed using XML adapters, with a click listener to open news items in a browser.

methods.name: onCreate
methods.description: Sets up the activity, loads the RSS feed into a list adapter, and attaches a click listener for list items.
